diagnostics.message: When VPC networking is enabled, aws_lambda_function.scale_up must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_up_vpc_execution_role so its execution role has ENI permissions during creation and retains them through deletion.

When VPC networking is enabled, aws_lambda_function.scale_down must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_down_vpc_execution_role; the role reference alone does not ensure the ENI permissions required for provisioning are attached.

When VPC networking is enabled, aws_lambda_function.ssm_housekeeper must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm_housekeeper_vpc_execution_role to supply the ENI permissions required during provisioning.
When VPC networking is enabled, aws_lambda_function.pool must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.pool_vpc_execution_role so ENI permissions exist before function provisioning.
When VPC networking is enabled, aws_lambda_function.main must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.vpc_execution_role so the execution role has ENI permissions before provisioning.

aws_lambda_event_source_mapping.scale_up must wait for aws_iam_role_policy.scale_up, which grants the execution role SQS consumption permissions. Referencing the function does not order this policy, and mapping creation can fail without those permissions.

aws_lambda_event_source_mapping.job_retry must wait for aws_iam_role_policy.job_retry to grant its function's execution role permission to consume the retry queue before AWS validates and creates the mapping.

aws_scheduler_schedule.pool can become active before aws_iam_role_policy.scheduler grants its target role lambda:InvokeFunction. Order the schedule after this policy to avoid initial invocation failures.

aws_cloudwatch_event_target.scale_down should wait for aws_lambda_permission.scale_down so the enabled scheduled target cannot attempt invocation before EventBridge has permission to invoke the function.
aws_cloudwatch_event_target.ssm_housekeeper should wait for aws_lambda_permission.ssm_housekeeper so scheduled invocations cannot begin before EventBridge is authorized to invoke the function.
